ltv_slabs._note: slab based on PROPERTY VALUE; % is max loan of that value. Boundaries: <=30L, 30-75L, >75L

min_cibil._source: HDFC blog (homeloans.hdfc.bank.in) - NOT the official criteria page
min_cibil._note: Blog states ~700 accepted with extra income checks, 720-750 typical, 750+ for best rates. SOFT gradient not a hard gate (unlike ICICI's stated 700 floor). Below 750 = rate-load rather than auto-decline. Needs official-page or DSA confirmation of true minimum.

processing_fee._note: whichever is HIGHER (floor, not cap); plus applicable taxes. NRI/Value Plus/Reach schemes differ - not modeled yet. Other charges (legal, admin, valuation, prepayment) exist - deferred to full fee-schedule layer.

rate_band._note: Rate = repo + spread. Spread varies by CIBIL/profile. Repo set by RBI - re-check monthly. Effective = repo+spread at current repo 5.25%
rate_band._source: HDFC home loan interest rate page (homeloans.hdfc.bank.in)

foir_by_income_band._note: FOIR cap varies by income - proprietary, DSA-gated

accepted_income_proofs._note: HDFC checklist splits self-employed into professional and non-professional (same docs shown on their page). Schema split to match ICICI structure.

co_applicant_clubbing._note: Key remediation lever for FOIR-bound buyers. Clubbing spouse/parent income raises FOIR base. Haircut % and allowed relationships are lender-specific - DSA-gated. Co-applicant's own EMIs usually also clubbed.
